verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has code-level versioning of task runs (locked to the deployed code version, docs-7) and run history/state tracking (docs-10), which supports basic version awareness and review of automation runs via the dashboard. But there is no evidence of a rollback mechanism to revert a deployed automation to a prior version, no changelog/diff view for task definitions, and no approval-gated release/promotion workflow for automations themselves (only for individual tool calls via needsApproval, docs-22). missing for 10: explicit rollback-to-previous-version capability, version diff/review UI for automations, deployment history with revert action, independent evidence of rollback being used in production.
